create_mujoco_model_from_xml: create a MuJoCo model from an XML string defining a 2D particle with slide joints and motors
build_direct_trajectory_optimizer: build a DirectOptimizer instance with a MuJoCo model and planning horizon for trajectory optimization
run_trajectory_optimization: run direct trajectory optimization to find optimal configuration waypoints through a MuJoCo particle
print_optimizer_status: print the optimizer status including cost components, iteration counts, and gradient norm
recover_control_from_forces: recover actuator control signals from optimized inverse dynamics forces using pseudoinverse of actuator moment
